create_omnigen_processor: create an OmniGenMultiModalProcessor instance with a text tokenizer and max image size
process_image_omnigen: process an image file or PIL Image into normalized tensor format for OmniGen
process_multi_modal_prompt: process a text prompt with image tags into tokenized input with pixel values and image sizes
call_omnigen_processor: call OmniGenMultiModalProcessor to batch process instructions and images into model-ready tensors
collate_omnigen_inputs: collate OmniGenMultiCollator features into padded input_ids, attention masks, and pixel values
